## What

Describe the concrete change.

## Why

Explain the problem it solves and link any relevant issue.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. State anything not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows this repository's contribution instructions and license.
- [ ] Relevant tests or documentation checks have been completed.
- [ ] No private keys, credentials or personal guest information are included.
- [ ] Any normative VRP change is proposed separately in vrp-spec under its governance process.
